sourceNotes: Values are approximate representative placeholders for ruleset tuning, not a clinical nutrient database.

sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 51.5 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 23.1 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling. Omega 3 is 70 milligrams, not adding much omega 3, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 20 grams of carbs. Glycemic index is 20, helping with steadier carb behaviour. Fibre is 8.6 grams, with only modest fullness and digestion support, so that's a small downside for seeds. For seeds, fibre matters much more than raw carb totals.
